author: VeritaHire
description: Search 2.5 million+ live US jobs read daily from 19,000+ employers' own career sites, with posted pay, apply links, full postings and a check on whether a posting is still open. No key or sign-up needed.
name: VeritaHire Jobs

tools.name: search_live_jobs
tools.title: Find live jobs near a place
tools.description: Search US jobs that are live right now on employers' own careers sites (re-read on a schedule, retired within about 36 hours of leaving). Give what (title or keywords) and where (City, ST or ZIP), or remote_only. Returns up to 25 jobs with posted pay, what each posting asks for (education, licences, years), distance, when it was last confirmed, the employer's industry and size, the employer's own apply link, and a job_id for the whole posting. Only the filters given are applied; the "asks" are listed, never used to drop a job. To keep a daily feed for one person (e.g. from their resume), run the same search each day with posted_within_days=1, title_exclude for titles they do not want, and page through next_page.

what.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "registered nurse", "forklift"

min_pay.description: Minimum pay: annual, or hourly if under 300. Jobs that do not post pay are kept, listed last.

title_exclude.description: Comma-separated words; jobs whose title contains any of them are left out, e.g. "senior, travel"

page.description: 25 jobs a page; pass next_page from the previous result

annotations.title: Find live jobs near a place

tools.name: get_job
tools.title: Read one job posting in full
tools.description: The whole posting text from the employer, its requirement facts (education, licences, years required and preferred, skills), pay, any sign-on bonus it offers (the amount, quoted from the posting), benefits, whether it is still open, and the apply link.

job_id.description: VeritaHire job id, as returned in search results

annotations.title: Read one job posting in full

tools.name: save_search
tools.title: Email the person new jobs for this search, daily
tools.description: Sends one email to the person's own address. Their click starts a daily email of new jobs matching this search (still live on employers' own careers sites) and creates their free VeritaHire account if needed. Nothing more is sent unless they click.

annotations.title: Email the person new jobs for this search, daily

tools.name: report_problem
tools.title: Tell VeritaHire something is wrong
tools.description: Records a problem with VeritaHire data: a job listed as open that the employer's site shows closed (job_closed), wrong place, wrong pay, wrong employer name, a search that returned irrelevant results or missed jobs it should have found, or duplicates. job_id identifies one job; search holds the search arguments for a results problem. Reports are about data, not people, and a person at VeritaHire reads every one.

detail.description: What was wrong, in a sentence or two

search.description: The search arguments that produced the problem

tools.name: benchmark_role
tools.title: Competitive Hiring Report for one job posting
tools.description: Competitive Hiring Report, free summary, for the employer of one US healthcare, finance, IT, engineering, science, HR, legal or marketing job posting (nurses, therapists, pharmacists, accountants, bankers, software engineers, data roles, engineers, scientists, attorneys, recruiters, marketers) that is not filling: the posted pay range in that market (salary benchmarking) and how many employers are hiring it. The full report, first one free (request_full_report), names each competitor with the pay it posts and how fast it closes the role (posting up to posting down), and shows where this posting sits and how hard the role is to fill there. Measured from employers' own careers sites. Identify the posting by job_url (the careers-site link, or a veritahire.com/j/ link), job_id, or employer + title (+ city, state). A role not yet benchmarked returns status "building" with retry_after_seconds, the time until it is ready.

job_url.description: The posting's URL on the employer's careers site, or a veritahire.com/j/ URL

annotations.title: Competitive Hiring Report for one job posting

tools.name: request_full_report
tools.title: Send the full Competitive Hiring Report to a hiring manager
tools.description: Emails the full Competitive Hiring Report for a posting to the person who will use it (their work email). Their click creates a free VeritaHire account and opens the report. Nothing more is sent unless they click.

email.description: The email address the report goes to

annotations.title: Send the full Competitive Hiring Report to a hiring manager

tools.name: is_job_still_open
tools.title: Is this job posting still open?
tools.description: Checks whether a job posting is still on the employer's own careers site (VeritaHire re-reads employer sites and marks a posting closed within about 36 hours of it leaving). Returns open, closed or unknown, with the last time it was confirmed. Works for postings found anywhere, given the employer's careers-site link.

url.description: The posting URL (careers site or veritahire.com/j/)

annotations.title: Is this job posting still open?
